title: Lifetime Memory
text:
Would love to have this experience over and over. The crew was absolute gold. Made some new acquaintances, fresh and delicious snacks  beautiful weather. 

Also, the crew was extremely willing to help with some of my physical challenges and offered encouragement.. Luna and the Captain need a bonus!
author: Tonya_C

title: Amazing, relaxing, fun sailing trip in the afternoon sun ☀️
text: Me and my friend Harriet booked last minute onto the Barcelona Sunset Sailing tour on No Limits (name of the boat), it was such an amazing experience!! Albert, Ricard and Lupe looked after us from start to finish, they were so friendly, welcoming and provided a wonderful boat trip.  We had the option to have drinks and food, lounge on the bean bags under the sun, and go for a swim.  We even got to learn a little bit about No Limits herself! title: Sunset cruise
text: This boat tour was amazing. Miguel was the best tour guide. He was fun, informative, and very engaging with us as guests. We sailed through the harbor and saw the beautiful Barcelona skyline. If you are visiting Barcelona you must do this sunset cruise and you must go with Miguel! He will help you make memories to last a lifetime.

author: Kelly_B

title: Wonderful Adventure with an Amazing Skipper
text:
The adventure was absolutely wonderful! Albert met us at the security checkpoint and escorted us to the boat, where tapas and drinks were already waiting. I was lucky enough to spot dolphins during the trip, though I'd say this was more by chance - I wouldn't count on seeing them every time. We stopped for a refreshing swim and were treated to a spectacular sunset over Barcelona. 

I want to give special thanks to Albert, who proved to be not only an excellent skipper but also a genuinely pleasant person to spend time with. Highly recommended!
author: Victor_S
